title: Postdoctoral Positions (2027), Institute of Mathematics
about: Research-only postdoctoral positions in mathematics at Academia Sinica's Institute of Mathematics, appointed for 2+1 years (not renewable). Review began 1 November 2026; materials submitted by 1 December 2026 receive full consideration, later applications are evaluated on a rolling basis.
requirements: PhD in mathematics before taking up the position

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: requirement "Research-only positions, no teaching duties" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

requirement "PhD in mathematics before taking up the position" -> objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps." (supports research productivity; it does not replace the PhD requirement)

The photo is a generic default skyline of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with the Landmark 81 tower and the Saigon River, not Taipei.
